no_devices_found.title: No Fidbox found
no_devices_found.description:
No Fidbox was found yet. A Fidbox only advertises itself around its daily sync/wake moment, so it is invisible to Home Assistant most of the day.

To make it visible now:
1. Open the official Fidbox app and start a sync - this wakes the device.
2. Wait 30-60 seconds.
3. Press Continue to search again.

Tip: if the device stays invisible, place a Bluetooth gateway (ESPHome proxy) closer to the Fidbox location - the device is often built into the floor.

abort.not_fidbox: The discovered device is not a Fidbox.
